simulation.method: At most 256 sampled surface vertices per region; threshold is 0.3% of arch span unless supplied
simulation.limitation: Proximity hints can miss contacts or intersections. Absence does not establish clearance. Draft boundaries can create false hints.

advisory_findings.title: Weekly motion is an endpoint-based estimate
advisory_findings.message: Tooth regions and endpoint matches are automatic drafts. Intervening weeks use assumed timing with rigid translation and rotation interpolation, not observed weekly positions. Review the boundaries, numbering, alignment, and endpoint fit before interpreting changes.
